verdict.rationale: User-configurable background automations, such as scheduled jobs, triggers or recurring pipelines, are a plausible capability for a database service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents Qdrant offering any way to set up autonomous or recurring automations. Agent skills and the MCP server are about connecting AI assistants, and snapshots are one-off archives with no documented schedule, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
